{"source":"import Base

# A U32 row evolves thirty-two columns at once. These fields are the low
# binary planes of their aligned population counts; totals 8 and 9 wrap
# to 0 and 1, which cannot be mistaken for the only relevant totals, 3 and 4.
type Life.Tally is Data:
  Tally{one: U32, two: U32, four: U32}

def Life.Tally.add(+bit: U32, tally: Life.Tally) -> Life.Tally:
  match tally:
    case Tally{+one, +two, four}:
      +carry1 = (one .&. bit : U32)
      carry2 = (two .&. carry1 : U32)
      Tally{
        (one .^. bit : U32),
        (two .^. carry1 : U32),
        (four .^. carry2 : U32)
      }

def Life.Tally.row(+row: U32, tally: Life.Tally) -> Life.Tally:
  Life.Tally.add(U32.shl(row),
    Life.Tally.add(row,
      Life.Tally.add(U32.shr(row), tally)))

def Life.tick.fin(here: U32, counted: Life.Tally) -> U32:
  match counted:
    case Tally{+one, +two, +four}:
      is3 = (one .&. two .&. U32.not(four) : U32)
      is4 = (U32.not(one) .&. U32.not(two) .&. four : U32)
      (is3 .|. (here .&. is4 : U32) : U32)

# Counting the center as part of its 3-by-3 population turns B3/S23 into:
# total 3, or total 4 with a live center.
def Life.tick(north: U32, +here: U32, south: U32) -> U32:
  Life.tick.fin(here,
    Life.Tally.row(north,
      Life.Tally.row(here,
        Life.Tally.row(south, Tally{0, 0, 0}))))

def Life.pack.row(cells: List<&2, U32>, acc: U32) -> U32:
  match cells:
    case Nil{}:
      acc
    case cell <> rest:
      Life.pack.row(rest, (U32.shl(acc) .|. cell : U32))

def Life.pack(
  rows: Nat, +width: Nat, +cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match rows:
    case 0n:
      Nil{}
    case 1n+more:
      line = List.take(&2, U32, cells, width)
      rest = List.drop(&2, U32, cells, width)
      Life.pack.row(line, 0) <> Life.pack(more, width, rest)

def Life.sweep(
  rows: List<&2, U32>, north: U32
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match rows:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case +here <> +rest:
      south = Maybe.default(&2, U32, List.head(&2, U32, rest), 0)
      Life.tick(north, here, south) <> Life.sweep(rest, here)

def Life.unpack.row(
  width: Nat, +bits: U32, acc: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match width:
    case 0n:
      acc
    case 1n+more:
      Life.unpack.row(more, U32.shr(bits),
        (bits .&. 1 : U32) <> acc)

def Life.unpack(
  rows: List<&2, U32>, +width: Nat
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match rows:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case bits <> rest:
      List.append(&2, U32,
        Life.unpack.row(width, bits, Nil{}),
        Life.unpack(rest, width))

def step(
  width: U32, height: U32, cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  +span = U32.to_nat(width)
  Life.unpack(
    Life.sweep(
      Life.pack(U32.to_nat(height), span, cells), 0),
    span)

def evolve(
  turns: Nat, +width: U32, +height: U32, cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match turns:
    case 0n:
      cells
    case 1n+more:
      evolve(more, width, height, step(width, height, cells))
","hypothesis":"The concrete improvement remains a row-bitboard representation: each U32 carries an entire board row, and a three-plane ripple tally counts all column neighborhoods in parallel. Counting the center reframes B3/S23 as “total 3, or live total 4.” The repair moves inspection of the computed tally into Life.tick.fin, where counted is a parameter and therefore a legal Bend match scrutinee.","findings":"Confirmed and repaired: Bend rejected matching the local computed binder counted inside Life.tick. Life.tick.fin now receives that value as a parameter and performs the identical tally match and rule calculation. The algorithm and public contract are otherwise unchanged. The prior linked-list-indexing finding remains fixed, and no unresolved semantic finding remains."}
